summary: After a natural 1 on a save or ability check, it's used up to reroll; keep the new roll.
text: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for a saving throw or an ability check, you can use up this charm to roll again, keeping the new roll. In a fight it's used on its own; outside one it's offered after the roll.
